properties.site-address: Gas Works, Gas House Lane, Morpeth
properties.notes: Former gasworks site but the industrial buildings and gasholders have been cleared and there is an opportunity for infill redevelopment. Being on the edge of the town centre, the indicative yield reflects potential for a scheme at a slightly increased density. The land has been utilised for storage recently, enabled by an approved change of use application (16/00598/FUL).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
